title: Global uniqueness in smooth isotropic elasticity

result.label: Global uniqueness in smooth isotropic elasticity
result.statement: Proves that full static boundary displacement-to-traction data determine both smooth real Lamé moduli on every bounded connected smooth domain in ℝ 3 , provided μ > 0 and 3 +2 0 on the closure. Neither analyticity, proximity to constant coefficients nor prior knowledge near the boundary is required.
